actions.description: Hand grasps a pipette from the rack; a tip is already attached.
Pipette is moved to a yellow tube/strip rack and the tip is placed into a well/tube; likely aspirate or dispense, but liquid movement is not visible.
Pipette is lifted away from the rack and moved back toward the hanging pipette rack.
Pipette is returned to the rack with the same tip still attached.
Pipette remains hanging in the rack; hand later reaches toward it again.

reuse.evidence: The same tip is used in one visible well/tube and then left on the pipette, but no second different medium/sample/reagent use is visible.

surface.evidence: The tip is not visibly touching the bench, glove, tube exterior, or other non-sterile surface before use.

release.evidence: No tip drop, ejection, or unexpected release is visible.

install.evidence: The attached tip appears seated on the pipette and no wrong-size or loose fit is visible.

output.overall_summary: A pipette with a pre-attached tip is taken from the rack, used in a yellow rack well/tube, and returned to the rack with the tip still attached. No definite listed technique error is visible, though later reuse cannot be determined from this clip.
